tool.name: AcpypeParamsGmx
tool.description: : This class is a wrapper of Acpype tool for generation of topologies for GROMACS.

param.name: input_path
param.label: input PDB,MDL,MOL2 file
param.help: Path to the input file. Format: [input].[format]

param.name: outname_output_path_gro
param.label: output GRO name
param.help: Path to the GRO output file Format: [output].gro

param.name: outname_output_path_itp
param.label: output ITP name
param.help: Path to the ITP output file Format: [output].itp

param.name: outname_output_path_top
param.label: output TOP name
param.help: Path to the TOP output file Format: [output].top

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: basename
param.label: basename
param.help: A basename for the project (folder and output files).

param.name: charge
param.label: charge
param.help: Net molecular charge, for gas default is 0. If None the charge is guessed by acpype.

param.name: charge_method
param.label: charge_method
param.help: Charge method.
param.option: abcg2 - ABCG2 charges; recommended for GAFF2; not available in acpype 2023.10.27
user - charges read from the mol2 input file

param.name: multiplicity
param.label: multiplicity
param.help: Multiplicity (2S+1) of the molecule.

param.name: atom_type
param.label: atom_type
param.help: Atom type.
param.option: amber - protein force field set in protein_ff + GAFF
amber2 - protein force field set in protein_ff + GAFF2

param.name: protein_ff
param.label: protein_ff
param.help: Protein force field used with the amber and amber2 atom types; only written to the command line when it is not the default value, not available in acpype 2023.10.27.

param.name: qprog
param.label: qprog
param.help: AM1-BCC charges engine; mopac and divcon need a full external AmberTools.

param.name: keyword
param.label: keyword
param.help: Keyword of the mopac or sqm engine, ie: "qm_theory='AM1', grms_tol=0.0005, scfconv=1.d-10".

param.name: max_time
param.label: max_time
param.help: Maximum time (in seconds) for the sqm or mopac execution.

param.name: predindex
param.label: predindex
param.help: Antechamber atom and bond type prediction index, the antechamber -j flag; only 1, 4 and 5 produce a topology. Only written to the command line when it is not the default value, not available in acpype 2023.10.27.

param.name: gmx4
param.label: gmx4
param.help: Write Ryckaert-Bellemans dihedrals for the old GROMACS 4.0.

param.name: merge
param.label: merge
param.help: Merge lower and uppercase atom types in the GROMACS topology if their parameters match.

param.name: sorted
param.label: sorted
param.help: Sort atoms for the GROMACS ordering.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the acpype executable binary.
